title: [GMCP 203.005.05] Interoperability and quality: Production-grade stdio transport
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-005-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: GMCP serves and consumes MCP over stdio with byte-accurate framing, bounded lines/messages, strict stdout protocol purity, stderr diagnostics, environment and working-directory control, graceful cancellation and shutdown, child-tree cleanup, backpressure, timeout handling, and Windows/Unix parity. Crash, hang, malformed output, descriptor leak, and hostile child fixtures all recover without stranding resources. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
